title: Business Breakfast | Stock/Share Market News | 6th August 2026 || TV5 Money

recommendations.note: Stock to watch for next one year. Extremely good result, management transition to younger generation underway.
recommendations.detail: During his market view, Kutumba Rao said Biocon has been repeatedly suggested as an investment idea for one year and has now given an extremely good result with approximately a 350% profit spike. The younger generation is coming into management, Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw has spoken about the transition. 'This is one stock to watch even for the next one year.'

recommendations.note: Hold if already owned but not a very great stock. Premium valuations, company size is small vs peers.
recommendations.detail: A caller asked about buying Corona Remedies at the current price for the long term; the anchor directed the question to Kutumba Rao garu. He said if you already have some, hold, but it is not a very great stock. Pharma stocks are seeing some demand now so the Chennai ones are also becoming active; be careful. The price at around 2,097 carries premium valuations and the company size is small compared to other companies. Fundamentals are OK but not justified at this price.

recommendations.price: caller holding at 80; current price not performing
recommendations.note: Exit on rallies. Momentum is over for railway finance stocks. Shift to Bajaj Finance, Shriram Finance, or AB Capital.
recommendations.detail: A caller holding IRFC at Rs 80 asked whether to hold or shift to Aditya Birla Capital or Bajaj Housing Finance. Kutumba Rao said shifting is fine because IRFC is not performing at all. It is a momentum stock that multiplied in the last two years and then came into a long consolidation. The mojo (money chasing) has stopped for railway finance companies. Exit on rallies and shift to better stocks like Aditya Birla Finance, the evergreen Bajaj Finance, Shriram Finance, or AB Capital.

recommendations.note: Good consistent performer from Asian Paints group. Profit doubled in June quarter. Start accumulating around 600.
recommendations.detail: Caller Suratnachary asked about Apcotex Industries. The anchor directed to Kutumba Rao garu, who said it is a good company with no doubt, a consistent performer originally from the Asian Paints group. It corrected from above 700 to 635-636. Results are good -- profit has doubled, top line grew in the June quarter. On declines, definitely buy. Start accumulating closer to around 600. Makes synthetic latex, synthetic rubber, construction chemicals; good brand name.

recommendations.price: bought during hype at higher levels
recommendations.note: Good stock but entry was at wrong higher level during hype. All are good stocks, need patience.
recommendations.detail: Viewer Satyanarayan bought GE T&D, Hitachi Energy, and Siemens Energy and they fell. The anchor directed the question to Kutumba Rao garu. He said it seems they bought during the hype. These stocks moved into a firm bull trend in the last one and a half years, so the entry point at higher levels was wrong and patience is needed. All are good stocks -- hold.
